techniques.name: Wireframe type open
techniques.description: White ground with a layout guide: two horizontal and two vertical hairlines (very light grey, about 1 px at 720p) crossing to make a box about 25% wide and 4% high at centre, with a black node dot at each crossing. The premise words appear one at a time inside the box, each on its own frame (F3, F7, F11: one word every 4 frames, 0.17 s), centred, small (cap height about 1.6% of frame height). The guide box drifts slightly wider as the words arrive. Nothing else on screen.
techniques.routeReason: Hairlines and dots are divs; words are per-frame visibility from a schedule. No missing primitive.

sound.note: The first word appears 0.02 s after it is spoken (F3 0.12 s vs 0.10 s); the next two appear 0.21 s and 0.47 s before their words.

typography.entry: word-by-word cut-on, each tinted green for 2-3 frames then black

techniques.name: Guide frame opens to an object
techniques.description: The guide box grows outward on all sides past the frame edges in 12 frames (F37-F49) while its hairlines thicken slightly with motion; the words split apart with it (first word to the left, the rest to the right) and fade by F47; a dot at the exact centre, visible from F37, grows into a brushed-metal tile, 6% of width at F46 and 20% by F56. The tile is the only thing moving inward against the outward lines.
techniques.routeReason: growRect for the box, scale on the tile, opacity on the words. The metal finish is a linear-gradient with a diagonal highlight band; a real brushed texture would need missing:brushedMetalFill (a seeded noise stripe layer). Blender is not needed for a flat tile.

ease.name: power1.in
evidence: motion.json s001 camera 1.50-2.40 s push_in, ease.gsap power1.in, bezierRmse 0.031

sound.note: Runs under a five-word voice line about the raw starting point; the tile appears as the voice reaches its last two words (2.08-2.96).

techniques.name: Collapse to a point, then burst
techniques.description: The tile rounds its corners into a disc (F78-F81), shrinks on an accelerating curve to a 1% dot (F82-F84) while a ring of 8 small dots expands from around it into a sparse dot field (F81-F86); iridescent spheres of 5-30% frame width enter from all four edges over 5 frames (F86-F90), settling around the edges and leaving the centre clear; the problem phrase types in at that clear centre from F91. Ease: power2.in on the shrink; the spheres' entry reads as expo.out.
techniques.routeReason: Scale and border-radius on the tile, a seeded ring of dots, spheres as radial plus conic gradients with blur by depth. Missing a ready iridescent sphere: missing:iridescentSphere. Blender would give truer glass but the spheres are on screen 1.6 s; not worth it.

ease.name: power2.in
evidence: visuals/a1/t02-square-to-spheres.jpg F86-F90 spheres near final by F88

sound.note: Under the problem sentence; onsets at 3.27 and 3.74 s bracket the move but onsets are 5.3 per second here, so that proves nothing. Any whoosh is inferred.

techniques.name: Tinted word arrival ahead of the voice
techniques.description: Each word cuts on in a tint (green on the premise, red on the problem phrase) and settles to black ink over 2-3 frames. Words land a median 0.18 s before they are spoken (9 word pairs timed on the strips, range -0.81 to +0.04 s).
techniques.routeReason: Per-word colour interpolate over 3 frames from a word schedule.

sound.note: Text leads voice (strip times minus word starts): Every +0.02, great -0.21, video -0.47, past -0.18, agency -0.40, level -0.81, Make +0.04, it -0.17, yours -0.09 s.

typography.entry: cut-on in a tint, settle to ink in 2-3 frames

techniques.name: Implode and blur away
techniques.description: The phrase leaves word by word from the front (F117-F119). The sphere field pulls into a tight ring at centre in 5 frames (F118-F122), overlaps into a cluster about 15% wide, then shrinks to about 5% while gaining a chromatic, defocused halo and fading (F122-F130). The embossed white maze ground fades in under the last wisp at F131 and the first wordmark letter appears at F132.
techniques.routeReason: Position track per sphere towards centre, then group scale with blur and an RGB-split filter. Shutter for motion blur during the 5-frame pull.

ease.name: circ.out
evidence: motion.json s002 camera 5.14-5.82 s pull_out, ease.gsap circ.out, bezierRmse 0.010

sound.note: The brand name is spoken at 5.12 s, in the middle of the collapse; the wordmark appears 0.38 s after it.

techniques.name: Letter-by-letter wordmark
techniques.description: The wordmark types on left to right, centred, each letter fading in over about 2 frames, 9 letters in 19 frames (F132-F151); the first letter flashes green as the premise words did. On the end card the same type-on runs faster (about 1 letter per frame, F441-F446) in white.
techniques.routeReason: typingSchedule and typedCount give letters per frame; library caption-typewriter or TypedLine.

sound.note: Starts 0.38 s after the name is spoken the first time and 0.11 s after the second time.

typography.entry: typewriter, left to right, about 2 frames per letter, soft 2-frame fade per letter

evidence: visuals/a1/t14-fill-to-endcard.jpg F441-F446 (24 fps, about 1 letter a frame)

techniques.name: Element grows into the next ground
techniques.description: A capsule at centre becomes the next scene's ground. Product beat: a pink-teal gradient pill fills behind the wordmark at F157 and grows to a 93%-wide card in 4 frames (F159-F162), the ground pattern fading under it. CTA: the navy button grows from 48% (F412) through 59% (F426) and 88% (F431) to full bleed at F436, slow then fast; its top sheen becomes the dark rim of the end card; the label fades F437-F440.
techniques.routeReason: Exactly the library's caused-morph (rect mode) and GrowToScene; the end card is the button's own gradient scaled, so no second asset.
requiredPrimitives: mesh-gradient (library block) for the pink-teal ground

ease.name: sine.in
evidence: motion.json s005 camera 17.11-18.02 s push_in, ease.gsap sine.in

sound.note: Runs under 'starts tonight' (17.31-18.10); full bleed at 18.18 s, 0.10 s before the brand name is spoken again. An onset at 18.065 s; what made it is unknown. The growth starts 0.09 s from a tracked beat; tempo confidence 0.12, so no beat claim.

evidence: visuals/a1/t05-card-to-collage.jpg F157-F163 (grows F159-F162, 4 frames at 24 fps)

techniques.name: Interface panels fly in from the edges
techniques.description: Onto the full gradient card, six dark interface panels (each 10-25% of width) slide in from the right, bottom, left and top edges, one every 1-2 frames over 8 frames (F164-F172), overlapping the card's edges so the card reads as a desk of real screens; a central button stays still at centre.
techniques.routeReason: Panels must be the real product's screens (capture:app, never generic stand-ins), placed with collageCells and a per-panel stagger.

ease.name: expo.out
evidence: visuals/a1/t05-card-to-collage.jpg F164-F172 panels near rest one frame after entry

sound.note: Under the words naming the audience (6.72-8.00).

techniques.name: Shrink, then cut
techniques.description: The full card shrinks towards centre with growing corner radius, from about 91% to 63% wide in 8 frames (F185-F192), accelerating, then a hard cut at F193 to the globe scene whose circle outline is already larger than the frame and pulls out.
techniques.routeReason: Scale and border-radius track on the outgoing scene, then a plain cut in TransitionSeries.

sound.note: Cut lands 0.05 s before the word after the audience noun. Nearest beat 0.23 s away (tempo confidence 0.12; no beat claim).

techniques.name: Two words flanking the image at the frame edges
techniques.description: Two small words are pinned at the far left (x 0.056) and far right (x 0.873) of the frame at mid height, with a pastel dotted globe (about 30% of width) inside a thin circle between them. The circle pulls out after the cut (expo.out, fitted 8.12-8.80 s on the detector shot that now covers this scene); the globe colours drift from pink to blue while it rotates slowly.
techniques.routeReason: Words are absolutely placed; the globe is points on a sphere projected per frame (ThreeCanvas with useCurrentFrame, or a 2D projection). No ready block: missing:dotGlobe.

ease.name: expo.out
evidence: motion.json s003 camera 8.12-8.80 s pull_out (fitted on detector s003; the move is the globe circle in corrected shot s002.3)

sound.note: Both words are on screen 0.40 s before the first is spoken and 0.81 s before the second.

typography.entry: cut on with the scene, both at once, at opposite edges

techniques.name: Raw material becomes the finished interface
techniques.description: The grey tile, split by a horizon line in its gradient, widens from 20% to about 33% and tints from grey to pale blue over 6 frames (F270-F276); at F277 it is a dark-blue landing page whose white sheen arc sits where the horizon was, with a small button hanging under its bottom edge; it widens to about 60% by F281 and its headline types in over 4 frames (F282-F285).
techniques.routeReason: morphRect for the size, a colour track for the tint, crossfade into a real page capture (capture:app or the product's own repo) inside the same rect. The page must be the real one.

sound.note: Under a six-word voice line about work people want to watch (11.00-12.82).

techniques.name: Spring pop on the cut
techniques.description: Hard cut to two stacked glossy buttons at 33% of width; the front button springs to about 53% with roughly 10% overshoot and settles within 8 frames (F324-F332), its colour moving from dark navy to bright blue as it grows. Fitted spring: stiffness 13.8, damping 2.33, mass 1.
techniques.routeReason: Remotion spring() with the fitted constants.

ease.name: back.out
evidence: motion.json s004 camera 13.52-13.65 s, pick spring, overshoot 0.103

sound.note: The cut is 0.07 s after the sentence's first word starts (13.44 s). Nearest tracked beat 0.07 s away, but the tempo estimate has confidence 0.12, so no beat claim.

techniques.name: Card shuffle swap
techniques.description: The rear button (grey, half hidden above) rises and comes forward over the front one in 6 frames (F342-F348) while the front button drops, shrinks and darkens to navy behind it; the swap lands on the second offer item's verb.
techniques.routeReason: z-order flip at the midpoint with y, scale and colour tracks; close to the library's ui-toast-stack.

sound.note: Starts with the spoken verb at 14.28 s.

techniques.name: Recentring word-by-word line
techniques.description: After a hard cut to plain white, a short sentence builds word by word (F366, F369, F375), the line recentring at each word (OCR box x 0.40 for one word, 0.325 for four), colour moving from navy #00257D to blue #408BF6 over the first 3 frames. Four words fill about 36% of width.
techniques.routeReason: Library type-sentence-build or BuildingCaption with a per-word schedule and centred layout.

sound.note: Cut 0.045 s after the first spoken word; words land +0.04, -0.17, -0.09 s against speech.

techniques.name: Sentence collapses into the button
techniques.description: The sentence fades out from its first word (F386-F388); a 12%-wide blue pill appears at the middle word (F389) and slides right over the last word (F389-F397); it pales to a light-blue ghost (F393-F405) and at F412 snaps in one frame to a saturated navy button 48% wide carrying the CTA label, then grows on. Ease: power2.out on the slide; the colour snap is a one-frame step.
techniques.routeReason: Per-word opacity, a morphRect pill, a colour track, and a one-frame state change. No missing primitive.

sound.note: The snap (17.18 s) is 0.07 s after an onset at 17.113 s and between spoken words; whether a sound effect marks it is inferred, not heard.

typography.entry: appears inside the pill at the snap

techniques.name: Wordmark slides aside for the address
techniques.description: On the end card the centred white wordmark slides left by about 13% of width over 9 frames (F468-F477); from F473 a white capsule grows from a thin bar to its right, and the address types into it one character per frame (F474-F486), blue-grey on white.
techniques.routeReason: track for the slide, growRect for the capsule, typingSchedule for the address; library scene-end-card is the nearest block.

sound.note: No speech after 18.9 s; the last audio section (19.11-22.66) has energy 0.13 against 0.44 before, and one onset at 20.92 s. Whether music continues quietly cannot be told without hearing.

typography.entry: capsule grows, then typewriter one character per frame

techniques.name: Quiet end-card hold
techniques.description: After the address finishes typing, the end card holds 2.3 s with no new element: only a very slow drift of the card (motion.json s006 linear, 19.67-22.53 s) under wordmark and address. The final frame is the full end card with no fade.
techniques.routeReason: A still composition with a linear drift track.

ease.name: none
evidence: motion.json s006 camera 19.67-22.53 s, ease.gsap none

sound.note: No voice; quiet section. Any music tail is unheard.
